ItemID: NA; Title: The Essential John Denver; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: His melodic folk songs fit my Simon & Garfunkel, Jonathan Edwards, and Melanie listening; I would choose this collection.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Peter, Paul and Mary; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: This fits my interest in folk harmonies and older hits collections; I would choose it now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Elton John: Goodbye Yellow Brick Road; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Melodic classic pop and rock fits my Beatles and classic rock listening; I would try this album.
ItemID: NA; Title: Chicken Skin Music; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not recognize this title well enough to choose it over the familiar collections here.
ItemID: NA; Title: Changes in Latitudes Changes in Attitudes; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The relaxed melodic sound appeals, but I would prioritize the folk collections this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: ZZ Top's First Album; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues-heavy rock is less appealing right now than the vocal melodies and older pop hits I have been choosing.
ItemID: NA; Title: NOW 60; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Born This Way listening suggests some pop interest, but I would need the track list before choosing this compilation.
ItemID: NA; Title: Older; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not give me enough confidence that it matches what I want to hear now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Very Best of Jethro Tull; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A classic rock hits collection fits part of my history, but I am more drawn to the folk and pop selections today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Pain Killer; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot identify the artist or sound from this title, so I would pass this time.
